title: Data Architect/Tech Lead
description:
### **Tech Lead / Junior Data Architect — Microsoft Fabric \& Azure heavy**


**Department:** Data Analytics
  

**Experience:** 8–10 years
  

**Location:** Ahmedabad/ Remote
  

  

**About Simform:**


Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well\-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.


### **Role Summary**


You will lead a small delivery pod building modern data platforms on Microsoft Fabric and Azure for global clients — from discovery and architecture through to production hand\-over. This is a hands\-on lead role: roughly 60% architecture and build, 40% technical leadership, code review, and client\-facing communication. It is positioned as an entry point into our Data Architect track, so the person who does this well grows into owning platform architecture across multiple accounts.


### **What you'll do**


* Design end\-to\-end lakehouse/medallion architectures on Microsoft Fabric — OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks (PySpark), and Direct Lake semantic models.
* Own technical decisions on a project: storage layout, ingestion patterns, orchestration, incremental load strategy, capacity sizing (F\-SKUs), and cost/performance trade\-offs.
* Lead a team of 3–6 data engineers and BI developers — task breakdown, estimation, PR/peer reviews, and quality gates.
* Translate client requirements into architecture and estimates; participate in discovery workshops and technical presales conversations.
* Implement data governance and security: workspace and RBAC design, row\-level security, sensitivity labels, lineage and cataloguing (Microsoft Purview), data quality rules.
* Set up CI/CD and environment promotion using Fabric deployment pipelines, Git integration, and Azure DevOps.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards — naming conventions, documentation, reusable frameworks, testing.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to internal capability building, POCs, and reusable accelerators.

### **Must\-have skills**


* 8–10 years in data engineering/analytics, with **at least 2 years hands\-on on Microsoft Fabric** in a production (not POC\-only) capacity.
* Strong Azure data stack: Azure Data Factory / Synapse, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and an understanding of networking basics (VNet, private endpoints, gateways).
* Advanced SQL and solid Python/PySpark for transformation at scale.
* Dimensional modeling depth — star schema, SCDs, conformed dimensions — and the judgment to know when to break the rules.
* **Power BI semantic modeling:** DAX, composite/Direct Lake models, performance tuning, deployment pipelines.
* **Data governance exposure:** Microsoft Purview or Atlan/Collibra — catalog, lineage, classification, data quality.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: has led a team or workstream, reviewed others' code, and been accountable for delivery quality.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable presenting a design to a client architect and defending it.

### **Good to have**


* Hands\-on **Databricks or Snowflake** (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, dbt) — we run multi\-platform engagements and cross\-platform fluency is valued.
* dbt, Dagster, or similar transformation/orchestration frameworks.
* Real\-time/streaming: Fabric Real\-Time Intelligence, Event Streams, KQL.
* Migration experience: on\-prem SQL/SSIS, Synapse, or Tableau Fabric/Power BI.
* Exposure to Fabric Copilot / Data Agents or AI\-on\-lakehouse patterns.
* Certifications: DP\-600 / DP\-700, DP\-203, or Azure Solutions Architect.

### **What we're looking for beyond the tech**


* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just tickets.
* Explains trade\-offs in business terms, not only technical ones.
* Comfortable with ambiguity — client requirements arrive incomplete, and we expect you to ask the right questions rather than wait.
* Genuinely enjoys mentoring; the team's growth is part of the job description, not a side effect.

title: IoT Engineer – Telematics & C#/.NET
description:
**IoT Engineer – Telematics \& C\#/.NET**

**Experience : 05\+ Years**

**Location : Ahmedabad**

**ABOUT MYFMS**

MyFMS is Micpoint B.V.'s SaaS platform for fleet, facility, and access management, built on .NET and C\#, and hosted on our own private cloud in the Netherlands, spread across two data centers. A key part of MyFMS is its connector layer: the software that links telematics and IoT hardware in the field (such as GPS trackers and CAN\-bus interfaces) to the platform. To further build out and standardize this layer, we're looking for an IoT Engineer with C\#/.NET development experience.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Implement and maintain telematics integrations in C\#/.NET on MyFMS's connectors, which link telematics hardware (e.g. GPS trackers and CAN\-bus interfaces) to the platform.
* Investigate which configurations, protocol settings, and command sets of supported hardware (e.g. CAN/LVCAN parameters) can serve as a standard, and document them.
* Research and manage firmware versions for telematics devices, and advise on firmware updates and compatibility.
* Translate device\-specific protocols into a uniform, reusable data structure within the platform.
* Document device configurations and firmware standards in Markdown for the development team and support organization.
* Work according to our DevOps way of working, integrating your work into the CI/CD pipelines we use for testing and releases.
* Collaborate with the (international) development team on the architecture of the connector layer and contribute to the technical roadmap.
* Support troubleshooting of field issues, such as connectivity or synchronization problems with hardware.
* Build simulators for telematics hardware, so protocols, configurations, and firmware behavior can be tested without needing physical devices.
* Use AI, and work with and train models, to build simulations and test setups.
* Ensure the connector integrations are fully testable (including unit and integration tests), safeguarding the quality of the telematics integrations.

**WHAT THE ROLE REQUIRES**

* Bachelor's/Master's level thinking and working ability in a technical field, e.g. Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or similar.
* Demonstrable experience with software development in C\#/.NET.
* Affinity with or experience in IoT/telematics hardware, such as GPS trackers, CAN\-bus interfaces, and sensors.
* Experience with Ruptela, Teltonika, and Digital Matter hardware is a plus.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, LVCAN, OBD\-II, MQTT, and/or TCP/IP is a plus.
* Experience reading, configuring, or updating firmware on embedded devices is a plus.
* Experience building test or simulation tools (e.g. device or protocol simulators) and with test automation (unit/integration tests) is a plus.
* Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (incl. Azure DevOps) is a plus.
* Affinity with AI/machine learning, for example training models for simulations and test setups, is a plus.
* You're analytical and structured: you enjoy bringing order to a wide range of device configurations and documenting what you find.
* You value quality assurance and structurally build testability into your own work.
* You're proficient in English, spoken and written (the team's working language); Dutch is not required.

**Ready to apply?**

Send your motivation letter and CV to ansuya.ghosh@nexuslinkservices.in or reach out via \+919023831263\. Questions about the role? Feel free to get in touch — we're happy to tell you more.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.

  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).

title: Project Executive – Founder’s Office, Admin & Operations
description:
Role Objective

Maharshi Industries Pvt. Ltd. (MIPL) is looking for a highly organized and execution\-focused Project Executive to work closely with the Founder and Management.

The role involves management coordination, tendering, administration, compliance tracking, recruitment support, project follow\-ups and cross\-functional coordination. The candidate will act as a central coordination point to ensure important tasks are properly documented, assigned, followed up and closed within timelines.

The role is ideal for someone who is proactive, dependable, detail\-oriented and strong at follow\-ups, with an interest in gaining broad exposure to the operations of a growing technology and defence company.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Founder’s Office \& Management Support

* Work closely with the Founder and Management on key priorities and follow\-ups.
* Convert management discussions into clear action items, owners and deadlines.
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely closure of assigned tasks.
* Prepare MOMs, trackers, reports, presentations and management updates.
* Coordinate meetings, documentation and information required for management decisions.
* Maintain confidentiality of management, employee, commercial and project information.

2\. Tendering \& Government Opportunities

* Identify and track relevant opportunities through GeM, CPPP/e\-procurement and other government portals.
* Review tender requirements, eligibility criteria, timelines and required documentation.
* Coordinate with Technical, Sales, Finance and Management teams for tender inputs.
* Compile technical and commercial bid documentation.
* Support online/offline tender submissions and ensure timely compliance.
* Maintain tender trackers covering EMD/BG, submissions, clarifications, demonstrations, technical evaluation, commercial stages and results.
* Maintain organized records of submitted tenders and supporting documents.

3\. Administration \& Office Coordination

* Support day\-to\-day administrative activities of the company.
* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and service providers.
* Maintain company documents, agreements, records and correspondence.
* Coordinate travel, meetings, visits and other management requirements as required.
* Follow up on procurement and administrative requirements and pending approvals.
* Maintain organized digital and physical documentation.
* Ensure administrative tasks are completed within defined timelines.

4\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain a compliance calendar and tracker for recurring company requirements.
* Coordinate with CA, CS, legal, HR, ISO and other external consultants.
* Track renewal/validity of registrations, certificates, licences and company documentation.
* Follow up internally for documents required for tenders, audits and compliance submissions.
* Maintain proper version control and centralized records.
* Escalate upcoming deadlines and compliance risks to Management in advance.

5\. HR \& Recruitment Support

* Assist HR and Management in recruitment for technical and non\-technical positions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, colleges and other channels.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and coordinate interviews.
* Schedule interviews with technical teams and Management.
* Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding availability, offers and joining.
* Maintain recruitment trackers covering open positions, candidates, interview status, offers and joining dates.
* Assist with onboarding documentation and employee records.
* Support HR in preparing routine letters, documentation and employee\-related MIS.

6\. Project \& Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Track project milestones, deliverables and pending actions.
* Coordinate between Mechanical, Embedded, AI/Software, Purchase, Accounts, Sales and Management teams.
* Follow up with responsible employees for project actions and deadlines.
* Identify delays and escalate bottlenecks to Management.
* Maintain project/action trackers and provide concise status updates.

7\. MIS \& Reporting

* Maintain centralized trackers for:
* Management action items
* Tenders
* Projects
* Recruitment
* Compliance
* Administrative activities
* Prepare weekly MIS and status reports for Management.
* Highlight Completed / Pending / Delayed / Critical actions.
* Ensure Management has clear visibility of important activities and pending actions.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Extremely strong in follow\-up and task closure.
* Organized and systematic in working.
* Comfortable working directly with Founders and Senior Management.
* Good at Excel, Word, PowerPoint and documentation.
* Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong in written and verbal communication.
* Detail\-oriented and responsible.
* Comfortable coordinating with engineers, HR, Finance, vendors and consultants.
* Trustworthy with confidential information.
* Proactive and capable of taking ownership.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving MSME/technology environment.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad?
* Do you have hands\-on experience in preparing MIS reports, trackers, MOMs, presentations and maintaining documentation?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC ?
* What is your Notice Period ?

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Relevant: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
